provider: ntwin32/office_sal (OFFSAL.DLL, Win98 SE KERNEL32-only static imports)

semantics.W file APIs: W->ACP with exact round-trip, else ERROR_NO_UNICODE_TRANSLATION (1113); >=260 -> 206; \\?\ prefix -> 123; find-data names verified back
semantics.InetPtonW/InetNtopW: IPv4 strict dotted decimal (no leading zeros); AF_INET6 -> WSAEAFNOSUPPORT
semantics.GetAddrInfoW/GetNameInfoW: legacy resolver (gethostbyname etc. loaded at run time), IPv4 only, ASCII host names, unsupported flags WSAEINVAL

not_covered: pipe.cxx (no local named pipes on Win98: OfsCreateNamedPipeW/WaitNamedPipeW exported, unpatched)
backtrace.cxx/signal.cxx (OfsCaptureStackBackTrace exported; dbghelp SymFromAddr and WER absent: not patched)
file.cxx and remaining W calls (GetVolumeInformationW, GetDiskFreeSpaceExW, WNet*W, GetNamedSecurityInfoW, GetLogicalDriveStringsW)
upstream_base_note: socket.cxx and file_dirvol.cxx are untouched by office_win98_sal_startup.patch; both patches can be applied independently
